_purpose: Authoritative sources to monitor for GRC framework updates. Used by framework_monitor.py and announcement_monitor.py to detect version changes, draft releases, and public-comment periods.

nist-800-53.label: NIST SP 800-53 Controls Catalog
nist-800-53.version_signal: revision history section or document revision date

announcement_feeds.notes: NIST Cybersecurity Insights blog RSS (replaces deprecated /news-events/cybersecurity/rss)
NIST Cybersecurity Insights blog

nist-800-53.next_expected_version: Rev 5.2 or Rev 6 (not yet announced; monitor csrc.nist.gov)
nist-800-53.cci_coverage_notes: Mixed: Full CCI coverage across all 18 control families. Confirmed-Direct: IA-8 PIV (CCI-001764, CCI-001948 — names PIV/SP800-63 explicitly). Confirmed-Subject: SC-13 (CCI-002450–002453, 'FIPS-validated cryptography'), IA-7 (CCI-000803–000804), SC-8(1) (CCI-002469), SC-28(1) (CCI-001199), SC-12 (CCI-002449, 'key establishment and management'). Implied-Bridge: ~30% of CCIs via r4→r5 bridge for Rev5-new controls. PM family Not-Applicable. See plan §7.10 for full per-control CCI provenance table.

nist-800-53b.label: NIST SP 800-53B Control Baselines

announcement_feeds.notes: NIST Cybersecurity Insights blog RSS (replaces deprecated /news-events/cybersecurity/rss)

nist-800-53b.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: Baseline profiles inherit CCI coverage from included controls. Baseline selection itself has no direct CCI; apply via the primary nist-800-53 entry at the individual control level.

nist-800-171.label: NIST SP 800-171 Protecting CUI
nist-800-171.notes: Rev 3 released May 2024; CMMC 2.0 currently references Rev 2. Monitor for CMMC alignment to Rev 3.

announcement_feeds.notes: NIST Cybersecurity Insights blog RSS (replaces deprecated /news-events/cybersecurity/rss)
Federal Register DoD RSS (replaces acq.osd.mil/cmmc/rss.xml which has SSL issues)

nist-800-171.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: 800-171 Rev 3 controls map to 800-53 Rev 5 via CMMC crosswalk; CCIs apply through that two-hop bridge. No direct DISA CCI List entries for 800-171 Rev 3. Rev 2 had partial CCI coverage via DFARS clauses.

nist-800-172.label: NIST SP 800-172 Enhanced Security Req for CUI

announcement_feeds.notes: NIST Cybersecurity Insights blog RSS (replaces deprecated /news-events/cybersecurity/rss)

nist-800-172.next_expected_version: Rev 3 (target May 2026; IPD out for comment)
nist-800-172.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: Enhanced requirements build on 800-171; CCIs apply transitively via 800-53 Rev 5 mapping. No direct DISA CCI List entries for 800-172 enhanced requirements.

cmmc.label: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC)
cmmc.notes: CMMC 2.0 Final Rule effective Dec 16 2024. Level 2 = 800-171 Rev 2 practices. Monitor for DFARS clause updates and Level 2→Rev 3 migration timeline.

announcement_feeds.notes: Federal Register DoD RSS (replaces acq.osd.mil/cmmc/rss.xml which has SSL issues)

cmmc.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: CMMC Level 2 → 800-171 Rev 2 → 800-53 Rev 4/5 → CCI (two hops). Level 3 → 800-172. IA.L3-3.5.3 (MFA): Confirmed-Subject via IA-2 CCIs (CCI-000765–768, 'multifactor authentication'). FIPS 201 PIV not required for DIB contractors; PIV CCIs are Implied-Bridge only.

fedramp.label: FedRAMP Program
fedramp.notes: FedRAMP 20x introduces KSIs (Key Security Indicators) as automated evidence. Monitor fedramp-automation GitHub releases for OSCAL baseline updates. 20x pilot tracked separately as fedramp-20x.

announcement_feeds.notes: Federal Register GSA publications RSS (replaces fedramp.gov/feed.xml which returned 404)

fedramp.cci_coverage_notes: Confirmed-Direct: FedRAMP inherits all 800-53 Rev 5 CCIs at baseline levels. IA-8 PIV (CCI-001948, CCI-001764–1769): Confirmed-Direct for FedRAMP High (PIV mandatory). IA-2 MFA (CCI-000765–768): Confirmed-Subject. FedRAMP 20x KSIs: Not-Applicable (no CCI equivalents yet).

hitrust.label: HITRUST CSF
hitrust.notes: v11.5.0 adds CMMC 2.0, DORA, ISO 29151, CMS ARS v5.1 mappings. Previously had v11.4.0.
hitrust.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: HITRUST CSF v11.5.0 is the 64-framework transitive hub. CCI connections derived via HITRUST→800-53 column mappings. HITRUST does not publish direct CCI mappings; all connections are Implied-Bridge via the hub crosswalk.

iso-27001.label: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
iso-27001.notes: ISO 27001:2022 released Oct 2022. Transition period ended Oct 2025. Monitor NIST OLIR for updated STRM mapping. ISO 27001:2027 amendment cycle may begin 2026.

announcement_feeds.notes: NIST Cybersecurity Insights blog RSS (replaces deprecated /news-events/cybersecurity/rss)

iso-27001.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: ISO 27001:2022 → 800-53 Rev 5 via NIST IR 8477 STRM OLIR (3,862 unified_mappings). CCIs apply at the 800-53 control end (two-hop: ISO ctrl → 800-53 Rev 5 → r4 CCI). ISO annex controls not in DISA CCI List.

disa-cci.label: DISA CCI List (Control Correlation Identifiers)
disa-cci.notes: CCI list maps to NIST 800-53 r4. Bridge via sp800-53r4-to-r5-comparison-workbook.xlsx.
disa-cci.cci_coverage_notes: Confirmed-Direct: This IS the CCI source. DISA CCI List (U_CCI_List) defines all CCIs with 800-53 Rev 4 control references and implementation statements. CCI numbers, definitions, and Rev 4 control IDs are authoritative. Rev 5 bridge via nist-r4-to-r5-bridge entry produces Implied-Bridge for Rev 5-only controls.

csa-ccm.label: CSA Cloud Controls Matrix v4
csa-ccm.notes: v4.1 released 2025 on GitHub (cloudsecurityalliance/cloud-controls-matrix). Previously pinned as v4.0.12.

announcement_feeds.notes: CSA blog and news feed

csa-ccm.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: CSA CCM v4.1 → 800-53 via CCM control baseline mappings. IAM domain → IA/AC CCIs; DSP domain → MP/SC CCIs; AIS domain → SA/SI CCIs. CCM control IDs not in CCI text; Implied-Bridge.

soc2.label: AICPA SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria
soc2.notes: 2022 update added criteria for cybersecurity risk management. ER crosswalk data from compliance-report-analyzer covers SOC 2 T1 and T2.
soc2.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: SOC 2 TSC criteria → 800-53 via ER crosswalk CSVs. CC6 (Access) → AC/IA CCIs; CC7 (Operations) → SI/AU CCIs. No direct DISA CCI entries for TSC criteria.

hipaa.label: HIPAA Security Rule
hipaa.notes: HIPAA Security Rule NPRM (proposed update) published Jan 2025 — final rule expected 2026. Covers enhanced cybersecurity requirements including MFA, asset inventories, network segmentation.

announcement_feeds.notes: Federal Register HHS RSS (replaces hhs.gov/rss/hipaa-news.xml which returned 403)

hipaa.next_expected_version: 2026 Final Rule (NPRM Jan 2025; comment period closed Mar 7 2025)
hipaa.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge (two-hop): HIPAA §§164.308/310/312/316 → 800-53 via HHS/NIST crosswalk → r4 CCI. §164.312(a)(1) AC → AC CCIs. §164.312(e)(1) Encryption → SC-28 (CCI-001199, Confirmed-Subject: 'encryption'). §164.308(a)(5) Auth → IA CCIs (Confirmed-Subject: 'authentication'). HIPAA section numbers not in any CCI definition text.

eu-ai-act.label: EU Artificial Intelligence Act (base regulation)
eu-ai-act.notes: Phased obligations: prohibited-AI Feb 2025, GPAI Aug 2025, high-risk Aug 2026/2027. Implementing acts tracked separately as eu-ai-act-impl.

announcement_feeds.notes: CISA Federal Register RSS (EU digital strategy RSS has malformed XML)
EDPB decisions/guidelines (replaces EU Parliament RSS which returned 404)

eu-ai-act.next_expected_version: GPAI implementing acts Aug 2025; high-risk implementing acts 2026-2027
eu-ai-act.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: EU AI Act is an EU regulation; no DISA CCI coverage. Closest 800-53 families (SA-11, SI-10, RA-3) have Implied-Heuristic connections at best.

nis2.label: EU NIS2 Directive
nis2.notes: NIS2 expands scope to more sectors; member-state transposition ongoing. Maps loosely to ISO 27001 / 800-53 via risk-management measures (Art. 21). ENISA implementing acts for incident reporting in progress.

announcement_feeds.notes: CISA Federal Register RSS (EU digital strategy RSS has malformed XML)

nis2.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: NIS2 Directive is EU law; no DISA CCI coverage. Art. 21 security measures → 800-53 families via Implied-Heuristic only.

eu-dora.label: EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA)
eu-dora.notes: Financial-sector ICT risk + third-party resilience. Applies from Jan 2025. Overlaps 800-53 CP/IR/SR families. RTS/ITS implementing standards finalized by ESAs.

announcement_feeds.notes: ECB press release RSS (covers DORA-relevant supervisory announcements)

eu-dora.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: DORA is EU financial regulation; no DISA CCI coverage. ICT risk management (Art. 6–16) → PM/RA families via Implied-Heuristic.

uk-gdpr.label: UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018
uk-gdpr.notes: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 amends UK GDPR. Monitor ICO for guidance updates and DSIT for secondary legislation.

announcement_feeds.notes: DSIT (DCMS successor) for legislative updates

uk-gdpr.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: UK GDPR / DPA 2018 is UK law; no DISA CCI coverage. Art. 32 technical measures → SC/AC via HITRUST bridge (Implied-Bridge at best).

iso-42001.label: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Management System)
iso-42001.notes: First certifiable AI management system standard. Complements EU AI Act / NIST AI RMF. Bridge via ISO 23894.
iso-42001.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: ISO 42001:2023 (AI Management) is a new standard with no DISA CCI coverage.

pci-dss.label: PCI DSS
pci-dss.notes: v4.0 mandatory March 2024; v4.0.1 errata June 2024. Future-dated requirements effective March 2025. Crosswalked to 800-53 via HITRUST hub.

announcement_feeds.notes: PCI SSC Blog — primary channel for DSS errata, clarifications, and next-version announcements

pci-dss.next_expected_version: v4.1 (not announced; future-dated v4.0.1 reqs active Mar 31 2025)
pci-dss.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: PCI DSS v4.0.1 → 800-53 via HITRUST bridge. Req 8 (Auth) → IA CCIs (Confirmed-Subject: 'multifactor authentication'); Req 10 (Logging) → AU CCIs; Req 6 (Patching) → SI-2 CCIs. PCI requirement numbers not in CCI text.

eu-ai-act-impl.label: EU AI Act Implementing Acts & Delegated Regulations
eu-ai-act-impl.current_version: Multiple; first acts adopted 2025 (GPAI Code of Practice, standardization mandate M/589)
eu-ai-act-impl.notes: Tracks delegated acts (Art. 97/98), CEN/CENELEC standardization mandate M/589, AI Office GPAI Code of Practice, and prohibited-AI enforcement guidance. Separate from eu-ai-act which tracks the base regulation.

announcement_feeds.notes: EDPB decisions and guidelines feed (replaces deprecated EUR-Lex EULAW RSS)
CISA Federal Register RSS (EU digital strategy RSS has malformed XML)

eu-ai-act-impl.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: EU AI Act implementing acts are EU delegated regulations; no DISA CCI coverage. Implied-Heuristic via AI-risk → SA/RA control families.

owasp-top10.label: OWASP Top 10
owasp-top10.notes: OWASP Top 10 2021 maps to NIST 800-53 SA/SI/SC families. 2025 edition in active development with data collection phase expected 2024-2025. Crosswalked to 800-53 transitively via HITRUST hub.

announcement_feeds.notes: OWASP Foundation news — catches Top 10 edition releases and data collection announcements
GitHub Atom feed for Top 10 releases

owasp-top10.next_expected_version: 2025 edition (second draft in progress as of mid-2025)
owasp-top10.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: OWASP Top 10 (2021) → 800-53 via CWE chain. A02 (Crypto Failures) → SC-13 CCIs (Confirmed-Subject: 'FIPS-validated cryptography'); A07 (Authn Failures) → IA CCIs (Confirmed-Subject: 'authentication'); A01 (Broken AC) → AC CCIs. OWASP category names not in CCI text.

owasp-asvs.label: OWASP ASVS (Application Security Verification Standard)
owasp-asvs.notes: v5.0.0 released May 2025. Previously monitoring v4.0.3.

announcement_feeds.notes: GitHub Atom feed for ASVS releases
OWASP Foundation news for ASVS announcements

owasp-asvs.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: OWASP ASVS v5.0.0 → 800-53 via CWE + formal ASVS→NIST mapping. V2 (Auth) → IA CCIs; V4 (AC) → AC CCIs; V9 (Comms) → SC CCIs. ASVS requirement numbers not in CCI text; Implied-Bridge.

cis-controls.label: CIS Controls v8
cis-controls.notes: CIS Controls v8.1 released June 2024 (minor update to v8). Includes Safeguards with IG1/IG2/IG3 implementation group tiers. Crosswalks to NIST CSF, 800-53, ISO 27001. Crosswalked to 800-53 transitively via HITRUST.

announcement_feeds.notes: CIS blog/news — catches Controls version updates and new Safeguard guidance

cis-controls.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: CIS Controls v8.1 Safeguards → 800-53 Rev 5 via CIS-NIST crosswalk (CIS Controls Navigator). IG1 Safeguard 5.3 (MFA) → IA-2 CCIs (CCI-000765–768, Confirmed-Subject: "multifactor authentication"); IG1 Safeguard 3.1 (Inventory) → CM-8 CCIs (Confirmed-Subject: "inventory"); IG2 Safeguard 8.2 (Audit Logs) → AU CCIs (Confirmed-Subject: "audit records"). CIS Safeguard identifiers not in CCI text; all connections Implied-Bridge via 800-53 crosswalk.

csa-star-ccm5.label: CSA STAR / Cloud Controls Matrix v5 (in development)
csa-star-ccm5.current_version: CCM v4.1 (current) current; v5 in development
csa-star-ccm5.notes: CCM v5 restructuring in progress — will change domain IDs and control structure. When v5 is released, canonical-sources/ccm-v4/ and source_manifest pinning will need updating. Separate from csa-ccm which tracks stable v4 for production use.

announcement_feeds.notes: CSA blog — primary channel for v5 preview/release announcements

csa-star-ccm5.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: CSA STAR uses CCM v4.1 as its control baseline (prior notes referenced v4.0.12 — updated to v4.1 as current per FRA-6). CCI connections inherit from csa-ccm entry. STAR certification layer adds no new CCIs; Implied-Bridge via CCM→800-53 chain.

nist-ai-rmf.label: NIST AI RMF 1.0 + GenAI Profile
nist-ai-rmf.current_version: AI RMF 1.0 (Jan 2023) + Generative AI Profile NIST AI 600-1 (Aug 2024)
nist-ai-rmf.notes: GOVERN/MAP/MEASURE/MANAGE functions. NIST AI 600-1 (GenAI Profile) released Aug 2024. Profiles for specific sectors in development. Bridge to 800-53 via ISO 42001 / HITRUST hub (ISO 23894 mapping).

announcement_feeds.notes: NIST Cybersecurity Insights RSS (replaces /news-events/news/rss which returned 404)

nist-ai-rmf.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Heuristic: NIST AI RMF 1.0 → 800-53 via NIST OLIR (draft). GOVERN/MAP/MEASURE/MANAGE functions → RA/PM/SA/SI families via Implied-Heuristic. No CCI definitions reference AI RMF functions.

ccpa-cppa.label: CCPA / CPPA Rulemaking (California Consumer Privacy Act)
ccpa-cppa.notes: CPPA actively finalizing rules on automated decision-making (ADMT), cybersecurity audits, and risk assessments. Final rules expected 2025-2026. Maps to NIST 800-53 PT/RA/SI families.
ccpa-cppa.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: CCPA/CPRA is California privacy law; no DISA CCI coverage. Security measures → MP/AC/SC via Implied-Heuristic.

iso-27701.label: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 (Privacy Information Management)
iso-27701.current_version: 2019 (amendment under development; aligned with ISO 27001:2022 expected)
iso-27701.notes: Extension to ISO 27001/27002 for PIMS. Maps GDPR, CCPA, and 45 CFR requirements to ISMS controls. Amendment to align with ISO 27001:2022 in development by ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27.
iso-27701.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: ISO 27701 extends ISO 27001/27002; CCIs via ISO 27001 OLIR bridge (two-hop: 27701→27001→800-53→CCI). Privacy extensions (P.x.x) have no direct CCI coverage.

oscal-format.label: OSCAL (Open Security Controls Assessment Language) Schema
oscal-format.notes: Critical for grc.db build pipeline — OSCAL schema changes may require catalog re-ingestion via oscal_diff.py. OSCAL v2.0 (metaschema-native) in long-term development. Monitor for breaking schema changes that affect NIST_SP-800-53_rev5_catalog.json.

announcement_feeds.notes: usnistgov/OSCAL GitHub releases Atom — primary signal for schema changes affecting ingestion
NIST Cybersecurity Insights RSS (replaces pages.nist.gov/OSCAL/feed.xml which returned 404)

oscal-format.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: OSCAL is a data format standard, not a control framework. The DISA CCI List is distributed in OSCAL format but the format spec has no CCI connection as a 'framework'.

fedramp-20x.label: FedRAMP 20x / Key Security Indicators (KSI) Pilot
fedramp-20x.notes: FedRAMP 20x replaces traditional continuous monitoring with automated OSCAL-native KSI assessments. Separate from fedramp (authorization templates). KSIs represent a new mapping layer between technical telemetry and 800-53 controls.

announcement_feeds.notes: Federal Register GSA publications RSS (replaces fedramp.gov/feed.xml which returned 404)

fedramp-20x.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable for KSIs: FedRAMP 20x KSIs are automated evidence artifacts, not control specifications. No DISA CCIs assigned to KSIs yet. The underlying 800-53 controls that KSIs test DO have CCIs (see fedramp entry), but KSI→CCI linkage is Not-Applicable pending FedRAMP 20x final rule.

enisa-pub.label: ENISA Publications (all topics)
enisa-pub.notes: Broad catch-all for ENISA technical guidance: NIS2 implementing acts, cloud security, critical infrastructure, AI security. High-signal for EU-headquartered customers. Filters by topic area in announcement_monitor.py.
enisa-pub.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: ENISA publications are EU cybersecurity guidance; no DISA CCI coverage. ENISA Threat Landscape → threat intelligence → RA/SI CCIs via Implied-Heuristic.

ncsc-guidance.label: NCSC (UK) Technical Guidance
ncsc-guidance.notes: Practical defensive security guidance from GCHQ/NCSC. Important for UK-headquartered customers. Maps loosely to UK GDPR / Cyber Essentials. Cyber Essentials certification scheme maps to CIS Controls IG1.

announcement_feeds.notes: NCSC UK all guidance RSS API endpoint (replaces /feeds/all which returned 404)

ncsc-guidance.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable: UK NCSC guidance publications are advisory; no DISA CCI coverage. Password guidance → IA-5 CCIs via Implied-Heuristic.

cisa-kev.label: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
cisa-kev.notes: CISA RSS feeds DEPRECATED May 12, 2025. Use GitHub mirror (cisagov/kev-data) as primary update signal. Daily refresh.

announcement_feeds.notes: CISA KEV data releases atom feed (cisagov/kev-data)

cisa-kev.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: CISA KEV inherits CVE→800-53 mapping from NVD. SI-2 (CCI-001643–001645): Confirmed-Subject for 'patch' / 'vulnerability' language. RA-5 (CCI-002515–002517): Confirmed-Subject. KEV-specific exploitability status not in CCI text — Implied-Bridge for the KEV catalog as a distinct source.

cisa-cpg.label: CISA Cross-Sector Cybersecurity Performance Goals

announcement_feeds.notes: Federal Register CISA feed

cisa-cpg.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: CISA CPGs 2.0 → 800-53 via CPG alignment table. CPG 2.E (MFA) → IA-2 CCIs (Confirmed-Subject: 'multifactor authentication'); CPG 2.F (Passwords) → IA-5 CCIs (Confirmed-Subject). CPG 1.A (Inventory) → CM CCIs. CPG identifiers not in CCI text.

cisa-scubagear.label: CISA ScubaGear M365 Secure Configuration Baselines

announcement_feeds.notes: ScubaGear GitHub releases atom (cisagov/ScubaGear)

cisa-scubagear.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: ScubaGear M365 baselines → 800-53 via ScubaGear control mappings. Teams/Exchange/AAD policies → AC/IA/SC CCIs. ScubaGear policy IDs not in CCI text; Implied-Bridge.

cisa-csaf.label: CISA Common Security Advisory Framework (CSAF)

announcement_feeds.notes: CISA CSAF GitHub releases atom (cisagov/CSAF)

cisa-csaf.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: CISA CSAF advisories inherit CVE→800-53 chain from NVD. SI-2 and RA-5 CCIs: Confirmed-Subject for vulnerability remediation language. CSAF-specific disclosure metadata not in CCI text.

disa-cci-trackr.label: CCI Trackr Public API (DISA CCIs + 800-53 mappings)
disa-cci-trackr.notes: Public REST JSON API (no CAC required) for 3,551 DISA CCIs with 800-53 mappings. Preferred over SAML-gated DISA portal for programmatic access.
disa-cci-trackr.cci_coverage_notes: Confirmed-Direct: cyber.trackr.live/cci provides the same CCI data (3,551 CCIs) via public REST API, including Rev 4 and Rev 5 control references where DISA published them. Rev 5 fields: Confirmed-Direct where DISA explicitly added Rev 5 mappings; Implied-Bridge where derived from the r4→r5 bridge workbook.

dod-zig.label: DoD Zero Trust Implementation Guidelines
dod-zig.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: DoD Zero Trust Implementation Guides (Discovery/Phase1/Phase2) reference 800-207 and 800-53 ZT activities. AC/IA/SC CCIs apply transitively. ZT pillar activities not in CCI text; Implied-Bridge via ZT activity → 800-53 → CCI chain.

jsig.label: Joint SAP Implementation Guide
jsig.notes: Classified annex; public version available from DNI. DoD SAP programs.
jsig.cci_coverage_notes: Not-Applicable for SAP overlays: JSIG is a classified supplement; public version limited. Standard 800-53 controls have CCIs (Confirmed-Direct/Subject as applicable), but JSIG-specific SAP tailoring not in CCI List. Implied-Bridge for standard controls.

icd-503.label: ICD 503 — IC IT Systems Security Risk Management
icd-503.notes: Intelligence community IT security baseline. NIST 800-53 tailored for IC.
icd-503.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: ICD 503 references 800-53 Rev 5 as baseline with IC-specific overlays. Standard control CCIs apply at baseline level; IC overlay requirements Not-Applicable (no public CCI definitions for IC-specific enhancements).

mitre-attack.label: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Framework

announcement_feeds.notes: MITRE CTI releases atom (mitre/cti — ATT&CK versions)

mitre-attack.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: ATT&CK → 800-53 via official NIST ATT&CK↔800-53 mapping (SP800-53_ATT&CK_v13_v1.xlsx; 195 techniques mapped). CCIs apply at the 800-53 control end. ATT&CK technique IDs not in CCI text; all Implied-Bridge. AC-2 CCIs (CCI-000004–000014) align with multiple ATT&CK persistence techniques.

mitre-d3fend.label: MITRE D3FEND Defensive Countermeasures
mitre-d3fend.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: D3FEND countermeasures → ATT&CK techniques → 800-53 → CCI (three hops). D3FEND technique IDs not in CCI text; Implied-Bridge.

mitre-capec.label: MITRE CAPEC — Common Attack Pattern Enumeration and Classification
mitre-capec.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: MITRE CAPEC → ATT&CK → 800-53 → CCI (two hops). Attack patterns not in CCI text; Implied-Bridge via technique→control connection.

mitre-cwe.label: MITRE CWE — Common Weakness Enumeration
mitre-cwe.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: MITRE CWE → NVD CVE → 800-53 → CCI chain. CWE-89 (SQL Injection) → SI-10 CCIs; CWE-79 (XSS) → SI-10 CCIs. CWE identifiers not in CCI text; Implied-Bridge.

nvd-cve.label: NVD CVE Feed (API 2.0)
nvd-cve.notes: NVD v1.x JSON gz feeds deprecated. Use API 2.0 with incremental date-range pulls (lastModStartDate/lastModEndDate params). No API key required for light use.

announcement_feeds.notes: NIST Cybersecurity Insights blog RSS (replaces deprecated /news-events/cybersecurity/rss)

nvd-cve.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: NVD CVE → 800-53 via CWE→CAPEC→ATT&CK→800-53 chain. SI-2 flaw remediation (CCI-001643–001645) and RA-5 vulnerability scanning (CCI-002515–002517): Confirmed-Subject for patch/vulnerability language. CVE IDs not in CCI text; all connections Implied-Bridge.

nist-privacy-fw.label: NIST Privacy Framework v1.0

announcement_feeds.notes: NIST Cybersecurity Insights blog RSS (replaces deprecated /news-events/cybersecurity/rss)

nist-privacy-fw.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0 → 800-53 Privacy controls via NIST crosswalk. PT/CT control families have CCIs via r4→r5 bridge. Most Privacy Framework core functions Implied-Bridge; Privacy-specific Rev 5 enhancements Not-Applicable.

ny-dfs-500.label: NY DFS 23 NYCRR Part 500 — Cybersecurity for Financial Services

announcement_feeds.notes: Federal Register NYDFS feed

ny-dfs-500.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: 23 NYCRR 500 → 800-53 via unofficial mapping. §500.12 (MFA) → IA-2 CCIs (Confirmed-Subject: 'multifactor authentication'); §500.14 (Training) → AT CCIs; §500.16 (IR) → IR CCIs. NYCRR section numbers not in CCI text.

glba-safeguards.label: GLBA / FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR Part 314)

announcement_feeds.notes: Federal Register FTC RSS (replaces ftc.gov/ftc-rss-feeds.xml which returned 404)

glba-safeguards.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: GLBA FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR 314) → 800-53 via FTC-NIST informal mapping. §314.4(c) Access → AC CCIs; §314.4(f) Monitoring → AU CCIs. eCFR as-of-date tracks changes. CFR section numbers not in CCI text.

ffiec-handbook.label: FFIEC IT Examination Handbook
ffiec-handbook.notes: Replaces sunset FFIEC CAT (Aug 31, 2025). Information Security booklet is the primary control framework; Audit + BCP as supplementary.

announcement_feeds.notes: Federal Register FFIEC feed

nist-csf.notes: CSF 2.0 released Feb 26 2024 — adds GOVERN function (GV.*). Direct STRM crosswalk to 800-53 Rev 5 ingested via 'nist-csf2-concept-crosswalk' (1,396 unified_mappings, 192 controls). CPRT JSON API for machine-readable access. Monitor for CSF 2.0 Profiles and minor updates.
nist-csf.cci_coverage_notes: Implied-Bridge: CSF 2.0 Functions/Categories/Subcategories → 800-53 Rev 5 via STRM crosswalk → r4 CCIs via bridge. No CCI definition references CSF functions (IDENTIFY/PROTECT/DETECT/RESPOND/RECOVER/GOVERN) by name. CSF 2.0 post-dates all CCI definitions. Highest-confidence: CSF PR.AC (Protect/Access) → AC/IA CCIs; CSF DE.CM (Detect/Monitoring) → AU CCIs.

monitoring_policy._purpose: Change intelligence for triaging crawler/monitor findings before re-pinning sources.

primary_vs_secondary.primary: Authoritative publisher (NIST CSRC, DISA, FedRAMP, HHS, AICPA, ISO, CSA, HITRUST, EC, ENISA, NCSC). A change is actionable only when confirmed here.
primary_vs_secondary.secondary: Aggregators/news. Discovery only — never the sole basis for a re-pin.

confidence_scoring.0.9: Primary source, >=2 independent signals changed (size + last-modified, or new version tag)

announcement_feed_policy.purpose: RSS/Atom feeds in announcement_feeds are early-warning signals — they appear weeks before PDF/Excel files change. They do NOT trigger re-pins directly.
announcement_feed_policy.action_on_match: Set action_items in announcements_feed.json; set human_review_required=true; notify operator to verify on primary source before acting.

change_type_vocabulary.major_revision: keywords: final, revision, Rev 6, version 2, new edition
change_type_vocabulary.minor_update: keywords: errata, correction, update, patch, clarification
change_type_vocabulary.draft_release: keywords: draft, IPD, initial public draft, RFC, pre-release, RC
change_type_vocabulary.public_comment: keywords: comment period, public comment, feedback, consultation
change_type_vocabulary.new_framework: keywords: new standard, introduces, first edition, inaugural
change_type_vocabulary.retired: keywords: withdrawn, superseded, retired, obsoleted, replaced

monitoring_policy.never_auto_apply: Source files are NEVER auto-downloaded into canonical-sources/. A human verifies the change on the primary source, then re-pins source_manifest.json and rebuilds the catalog.
monitoring_policy.robots_policy: Respect robots.txt. One honest User-Agent. Honor Retry-After/RateLimit-Reset. Back off, never bypass. No CAPTCHA bypass, no JS-evasion.

bridged_via_hitrust._note: These international/legal frameworks are crosswalked to NIST 800-53 transitively through the HITRUST CSF v11.4 hub (relationship_type=transitive_via_hitrust). They appear in unified_mappings without a standalone source file.
